case_study_title: Kensington and Chelsea Shared-IT Cyber Attack
priority_questions: Which Building & Public Works threat, incident and dependency pathways require management attention in the EU, EEA and UK, with global comparison?
Which public developments between 1 September 2025 and 14 October 2026 changed operational, financial or regulatory exposure, and what public outcomes are disclosed?
Which actions, challenge questions and monitoring triggers should 1LoD operational management and the Risk Committee prioritise?
regulatory_scope: EU NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555 and national transposition
EU public-procurement and cyber supply-chain requirements
UK NIS Regulations 2018 and UK cyber resilience legislative developments
UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018
UK procurement and public-sector cyber requirements
US and other global regimes as comparative evidence only
ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, ISO/IEC 27036, IEC 62443, NIST CSF 2.0, CISA guidance and CIS Controls as voluntary references
case_study_selection_note: Selected after discovery on 14 October 2026; see 01_research_plan.md and report Chapter 5 selection matrix.
